profile.headline: Software Engineer at Exponent Inc.
profile.summary:
QUALIFICATIONS PROFILE:

Technology inclined detail-oriented, innovative, and results-focused professional offering extensive experience and expertise in handling information technology systems and applications. Possess outstanding analytical skills in identifying high-risk technical problems as well as in developing and implementing effective troubleshooting plans and corrective actions. Demonstrate strong collaboration and team-building abilities in directing colleagues to achieve organizational goals and objectives.

AREAS OF EXPERTISE:
 
Software Solution Architecture & Complete Design Life Cycle (Design, Debug, Support), Object-Oriented Programming, Web/Desktop Applications Design/ Support, Business Process Improvement, Documentation: Requirements, Specification, Design, UML, Software Component Integration/Support, Database Design, Management, Reports, Strategic Planning and Execution

TECHNICAL ACUMEN:

Computer Languages/Technology: .NET (3.5, 4.0, 4.5), ASP.NET, ADO.NET, .NET Provider Model, ASP, C#, VB.NET, WPF, WWF, MVC, MVVM, WCF, Ajax, Visual Basic, SOAP, XML Web Services, Silverlight, Win32 API, C/C++, JavaScript, VB Script, jQuery, Backbone.js, Angular.js, SharePoint 2010, Transact SQL, PL/SQL, XML, CSS, Shell Script, HTML/DHTML

Database:	SQL Server 2008/2014, MySQL, and Oracle

Operating Systems: Windows Server 2008/2012, Windows 7/8.1, Mac OS, UNIX, Red Hat Linux

Software and Applications: Visual Studio 2008/2010/2013, MS Office, MS Project, SQL Reports

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Exponent (NASDAQ: EXPO) is an American engineering and scientific consulting firm that provides solutions to complex technical problems. Exponent has a multidisciplinary team of scientists, physicians, engineers, and business consultants which performs in-depth research and analysis in more than 90 technical disciplines. The company operates 20 offices in the United States and 5 offices overseas. Until 1998, it was known as Failure Analysis Associates and its holding company, The Failure Group, Inc., was traded as the symbol FAIL. It was founded in 1967 by five PhD level researchers from Stanford University and today employs over 900 people, including more than 400 PhD's and MD's. Although the company is mostly recognized for their roles in major accident investigations and failure analysis, the firm also provides a variety of engineering, environmental, health science and economics consulting services.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging · Code Refactoring · Code Review · Optimization · Algorithm Design · Algorithms · Technical Planning

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Support CalCPA website/CMS, implement enhancements, solve customer service issues, manage website releases and integrate third party software.  Technologies used are ASP.NET, jQuery, JavaScript, ASP.NET Web Services and Drupal for CMS.  Also used and modified Avectra netForum Pro as CRM and Bryce Web Group Society Solution as CMS.

company.name: California Society of CPAs/CalCPA Education Foundation

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Handle the design and implementation of various modules of CoursePacks application which allows professors and teachers to create custom course packets which can be purchased by students and faculty members.  Primary technologies used are ASP.NET, jQuery, ASP.NET Web Services, WPF, WWF, and WCF Services.

company.name: Konica Minolta Business Solutions U.S.A., Inc.

positions.title: Senior .NET Engineer
positions.description: Handle the design and implementation of various modules of the research information online web portal (ASP.NET). Develop and utilize third party software in improving the efficiency of workflow processes. Administer and update site security, SQL backups, and nightly processes; provided support in the development of bulk e-mail alert SOA applications, ASP.NET Web Services, SQL reports, and port old software using the latest tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Programmer/Technical Lead
positions.description: Oversaw the design and development of web applications and software tools for use by internal team of analysts. Provided assistance to analysts in producing commentaries on emerging market conditions by creating nightly processes for downloading and processing raw data into a more meaningful format they could use. Supervised a small team of junior programmers responsible for web site applications, site HTML design, and SQL reports. Adjusted and modified database objects, access, and design by conducting performance tuning of SQL server. Utilized C# (.NET) in creating add-ons that enable users to use current Office applications for writing and updating site content with rich formatting.
